lines.en: I've had an upset stomach and diarrhea since yesterday.
I have body aches and bad fatigue. I feel awful.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a fever? A cough?
lines.learner: 열은 없는데 콧물이 나고 기침도 해요.
lines.en: No fever, but I have a runny nose and a cough too.
lines.roman: Yeoreun eomneunde konmuri nago gichimdo haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: You have cold symptoms too. Do you smoke?
lines.en: No, I quit smoking last year.

lines.beaver_en: Good for you. I'll give you stomach and cold medicine.
lines.en: Also, I got bitten by a mosquito and my leg swelled up.

lines.beaver_en: Is it very itchy? Put on this ointment.
lines.learner: 이 연고는 하루에 몇 번 발라요?
lines.en: How many times a day should I apply this ointment?
lines.roman: i yeongoneun harue myeot beon ballayo?

lines.en: I've been very tired lately. Is that okay?

lines.beaver_en: It's probably from the body aches. Get plenty of rest.
lines.learner: 이 약에 대한 설명 좀 해 주세요.
lines.en: Please tell me about this medicine.
lines.roman: I yage daehan seolmyeong jom hae juseyo.

lines.beaver: 하루 세 번, 식후에 드세요. 총 삼 일분이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Take it three times a day after meals. Three days' worth in total.
lines.beaver_roman: Haru se beon, sikue deuseyo. Chong sam ilbunieyo.
lines.en: Okay, I'll make a note of it.

lines.beaver_en: That's 15,000 won in total. Get well soon.
